1-week event (around 16 to 23 April); the nest hunt takes 1–3 hours

Tibia's spring event (the former Easter event). For one week, dragon nests appear in the Dragon Lairs and hatch {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings} (which give 25% more experience), rabbits drop {item:Coloured Egg|Coloured Eggs} and there are {item:Hidden Nest|Hidden Nests} hidden around the cities. Find them to get {item:Surprise Nest|Surprise Nests} with sweets, chocolates, eggs and {item:Surprise Bag (Blue)|Blue Surprise Bags}.

Several adventurers have reported unusual activity in almost all known dragon lairs. Many dragon eggs have been seen in their caves and it is only a matter of time before the next generation of these nasty creatures hatches...
Part of the event is accessible to Free Accounts; some cities with nests are Premium only.

Each city has 5 hidden nests. Use the tables below and click the coordinates to open the map: many nests are in towers or on upper floors (z lower than 7).
The dragon nests in the Dragon Lairs do not respawn until the next {wiki:Server Save}.

Spring into Life replaced the old Easter event and includes everything that event had: during the event, {creature:Rabbit|Rabbits} drop {item:Coloured Egg|Coloured Eggs}, which you can also buy from some {wiki:Food Shopkeeper NPCs|food shopkeepers}.

In many {wiki:Dragon Lairs} all over Tibia, dragon nests appear which, over time, hatch {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}. During the event Dragon Hatchlings give **25% more experience**. The nests do not respawn until the next Server Save.
In the Dragon Lairs you will find several kinds of {wiki:Dragons|dragons}: don't go in if you aren't high enough level for them.

There are {item:Hidden Nest|Hidden Nests} scattered around the cities of Tibia. Find them and use them to get {item:Surprise Nest|Surprise Nests}, which you then use to receive assorted rewards (sweets, {item:Bar of Chocolate|chocolates}, eggs, {item:Surprise Bag (Blue)|Blue Surprise Bags} and possibly more). The following sections list the 5 locations in each city.

To go from one city to another, use the boats: at the port, talk to the captain and say {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:carlin}) and {key:yes}. To return, take the boat back at the port of the city you're in. Some cities are only accessible with a Premium account. The steps for Cormaya, Fibula, Yalahar and Svargrond explain how to get there.
The 5 nests of **Ab'Dendriel**. You need a {item:Machete} (or a similar tool) to cut {item:Jungle Grass} on the way to 3 of them.

The 5 nests of **Cormaya**: Cormaya is an island next to Edron: at the boat in the **north** of Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}). You land at the north port of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret}, who takes you back to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).

The 5 nests of **Fibula**: Fibula is south of Thais: you get there on foot through the tunnel that starts south of Thais ({coord:32261,32385,7}) and come back through the same tunnel.

The 5 nests of **Yalahar**: You get there by boat: {npc:Captain Max}, in Liberty Bay, takes you there if you have the Novice rank of the {wiki:Tibian Explorer Society|Explorer Society}. To come back, {npc:Captain Cookie}, at Yalahar's port, takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:liberty bay}) or to Thais ({key:thais}).
The 5 nests of **Svargrond**: Take the boat to Svargrond in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, who also takes you back.
The dragon nests in the Dragon Lairs and the Hidden Nests only exist during the event.
